title: Severe primary PPH with hemorrhagic shock — PHC with uterotonics and TXA, no blood products
scenario_note: Implements the FOUNDER_BRIEF MVP demonstration case: 29-year-old immediately postpartum, HR 124, BP 88/52, ongoing bleeding, EBL 1,100 mL, weakness/dizziness — extended with uterine tone, IV access, available medications, and blood-product availability fields. SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY.

vitals.mental_status: weak and dizzy, still responsive to voice

resources.referral_facility_capability: secondary hospital with surgery and blood bank

input.free_text_intake: Mama just deliver 35 minutes ago. She dey bleed steady, EBL around 1100 mL. Belle soft (boggy). She say she dey weak and dizzy. BP 88/52, pulse 124.

risk_rationale: EBL 1,100 mL >= 1,000 mL = severe PPH (WHO 2012 / RCOG)
Shock index 1.41 in critical band (>= 1.3) = hemorrhagic shock physiology
SBP 88 < 90 with HR 124 > 120 = red vital-sign ranges
Symptomatic hypovolemia (weakness, dizziness) with ongoing bleeding
Uterine atony (boggy uterus) = most likely 4T cause (Tone)
missing_info: time_of_birth_exact (needed to verify TXA 3-hour window — minutes_since_birth given as approximate; confirm clock time)
genital_tract_trauma_assessment (laceration inspection not yet performed — 4T Trauma)

first_5_prioritized_actions.action: Call for help / activate PPH emergency: summon additional staff, alert referral hospital and arrange transport NOW (45 min away), assign team lead and timekeeper.
Uterine (fundal) massage now — uterus is boggy (atony); reassess tone every 5 minutes.
Oxytocin 10 IU IM or IV SLOW (first-line uterotonic; prophylactic dose already given — repeat treatment dose per pathway). Never rapid IV push.
Tranexamic acid 1 g (100 mg/mL) IV over 10 minutes — patient is ~35 min post-birth, inside the 3-hour window (confirm exact time of birth).

Establish second large-bore IV and begin warmed isotonic crystalloid resuscitation in parallel; apply NASG as temporizing measure and prepare for immediate transfer (no blood products on site, SI critical).

blocked_or_flagged.note: Would additionally require documented non-hypertensive BP before any recommendation (gate G4).
NASG device-level contraindication list is UNVERIFIED in data v1 — senior clinician confirms before application.

escalation_expected.action: Immediate transfer to secondary hospital (surgery + blood bank) with NASG applied and resuscitation ongoing en route; do not wait for deterioration.
